    Rigid modules over a piece have no cocycles beyond coboundaries #

    For representations X, Y of a piece respecting the cover and a family F of relations generating those of the cover, a cocycle z of F gives an extension E(z) respecting the cover (respectsCover_extR). If every extension of the module of X by that of Y splits, a section is a morphism of representations, so z is a coboundary (cocycles_le_range_cob).
